author: Techlore
description:
Ledger Atom puts a second, secure computer inside a phone, built to keep your secrets safe even if the phone itself gets hacked. I went to Ledger Op3n 2026 in Paris to see whether it’s the future of phone security. Thanks to Ledger for flying us out!
